alerts.headline:
The right lane of northbound I-405 from Northeast Fourth Street (milepost 13.9) to Northeast Eighth 
Street (milepost 14.4) will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. – 8 a.m., starting the night of Friday, 
Nov. 6 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.

Saturday, Nov. 7.

night of Friday, Nov. 6 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.

Crews will close all lanes of northbound I-405 from SR 522 to SR 527 starting at 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9. A detour route will be in place. Adjacent ramps will also close.
The westbound SR 522 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed from 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6, to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9.
The Northeast 195th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed from 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6, to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to SR 527 will be closed from 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6, to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9.
Up to two lanes of northbound SR 527 near the I-405 interchange will be closed from 11 p.m. to 4 a.m. on Monday night, Nov. 9.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 195th Street will be closed from 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6, to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9.

All lanes of eastbound and westbound SR 522 will be closed between mileposts 10.65 and 10.97 from 10 p.m. Friday, Nov 13 to 7 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 14. Saturday, Nov. 14 to Sunday, Nov. 15 is held as a contingency.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.
Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed overnight, from 10 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 7 - 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 8.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of southbound I-405 between milepost 19.84 and milepost 18.11 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m., Friday, Nov. 6 – 6:30 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of southbound I-405 between milepost 19.84 and milepost 18.11 will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 6 – 8 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 8.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed overnight, 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 – 6 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7.

The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 – 7 am. Saturday, Nov. 7.
The 132nd Avenue Northeast on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed from 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6, to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight, 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 – 6 am. Saturday, Nov. 7.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 7 – 6 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 8.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 7- 6 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 8.
The 70th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight, 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 – 7 am. Saturday, Nov.7.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 7- 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 8.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight, 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 – 6 am. Saturday, Nov. 7.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed overnight, from 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 – 7 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the right lane of eastbound I-90 will close between East Mercer Way and I-405 for construction. Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 ramps to northbound and southbound I-405 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from East Mercer Way will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

From 7:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5 through Wednesday, Nov. 11, the road will reduce to one lane between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East. The lane reduction creates a work zone for Washington State Department of Transportation maintenance crews to prepare the roadway for winter weather. For more information, visit the project webpage.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from Talbot Road South/SR 515 (milepost 3.5) to Sunset 
Boulevard North/SR 900 (milepost 5.5) will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the 
night of Friday, Nov. 6 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from North 30th Street (milepost 6) to Talbot Road South/SR 515 
(milepost 3) will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Nov. 6 to the 
morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.

The SR 169 on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. – 6 a.m., starting the 
night of Friday, Nov. 6 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7. A signed detour will be in place.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Wednesday, Nov. 4 to the morning of Thursday, Nov. 5. A signed detour will be in 
place.
Northbound SR 167 from South 180th Street to I-405 will close overnight from 10 p.m. Monday, Nov. 9 to 3:45 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 10. Signed detours will be in place.

The right lane of westbound SR 523/Northeast 145th Street will close from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Oct. 26, through Friday, Nov. 13, from Interlaken Boulevard to Linden Avenue North for utility work.

From 6 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 14 and Sunday, Nov. 15, one lane of the southbound State Route 99 First Avenue Bridge (milepost 27-26) will close for maintenance. The right lane of the bridge will close on Saturday and the left lane HOV lane will close on Sunday.

From 9 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7, one left lane or two right lanes of northbound State Route 99 from South Dawson Street to just south of the Alaskan Way South exit (mileposts 27-30) will close for maintenance.

From 11 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 10 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 11, three right lanes of northbound Interstate 5 from North 85th Street to Northeast 145th Street (mileposts 171-173) and the on-ramp from westbound Northeast Northgate Way will close for utilities work.

From 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7, all lanes of eastbound Interstate 90 from Rainier Avenue South (milepost 3) to 77th Avenue Southeast (milepost 6) will close for maintenance. The eastbound I-90 on-ramps from Interstate 5 and Rainier Avenue South will also close. Lanes begin closing at 8:30 p.m.

Friday, Nov. 13, until the morning of Monday, Nov. 16 - Westbound SR 520 between Montlake Boulevard and I-5 in Seattle will close for construction beginning at 11 p.m. Friday until 5 a.m. Monday. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic crossing Lake Washington will exit at Montlake or Lake Washington boulevards. Those who need access to I-5 from westbound SR 520 will need to use alternate routes. Eastbound SR 520 and the SR 520 Trail are not affected by this work and will remain open.

Nightly from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Thursday, Nov. 12 to 5 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 14, three left lanes of northbound Interstate 5 from North 85th Street to Northeast 145th Street (mileposts 171-174) will close for utilities work.

Monday, Oct. 26, on most weeknights until Friday, Nov. 13 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to both northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction on most weeknights beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The typical closure dates are Monday through Thursday evenings, though some nights could be canceled based on needs and/or holidays. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on the bridge past Montlake and Lake Washington boulevards will detour to southbound I-5.

Saturday, Nov. 7, nightly until the morning of Monday, Nov. 9 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. During this time, all traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 will pay the SR 520 bridge toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need access to Montlake from I-5 must use alternate routes.

From 11 p.m. Monday, Nov. 9 to 4 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 10, three left lanes of southbound Interstate 5 from Northeast 155th Street to Northeast 177th Street (mileposts 175-173) will close for utilities work.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.
From 9 p.m. Monday, Nov. 9 to 5 a.m. Tuesday Nov. 10, the right lane of eastbound SR 526 will close at Seaway Boulevard (milepost 2) for utility work.

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.

Eastbound and westbound State Route 96 will alternate from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily near Lark Dairy Farm (milepost 6) for utility work until 2 p.m. Friday, Nov. 13 (except Saturday, Sunday and Tuesday, Nov. 10 to Thursday, Nov. 12.)
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
